import pandas as pd,numpy as np,model
d=pd.read_parquet('/data');d['date']=pd.to_datetime(d['date']);d=d.sort_values('date').reset_index(drop=True)
y=d.load.values;B=model._features(d.date,d.temp_forecast)
for w in [3,5,7,10,14,21]:
    m=d.temp_forecast.shift(1).rolling(w,min_periods=1).mean().values
    for c in [19]:
      for nm,f in [('abs',np.abs(m-c)),('h+c',None)]:
        if f is None: X=np.column_stack([B,np.maximum(17-m,0),np.maximum(m-21,0)])
        else: X=np.column_stack([B,f])
        n=len(y)//2
        # train first half test second
        b=np.linalg.lstsq(X[w:n],y[w:n],rcond=None)[0]
        print(w,nm,np.abs(y[n:]-X[n:]@b).mean())
b=np.linalg.lstsq(B[:300],y[:300],rcond=None)[0];print('base',np.abs(y[300:]-B[300:]@b).mean())
E
python /tmp/t.py
